items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions Charlie Nick in the context of St. Louis engagements, but there is no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between Zutty Singleton and Charlie Nick.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, when Zutty comes to St. Louis, with professional destiny laid out --

That's right, that's right. But to tell you how Charlie got started, and then so many people wanted his music, all the whites, you know what I mean, and the blacks. They'd heard about Charlie Nick come to hear him (unintelligible) until he couldn't -- our band couldn't play for these different engagements, but he'd tell them he would get them a band.
